name: Replit
description: Replit is a cloud-based development platform where Replit Agent can build, run, and deploy full applications from natural-language prompts, alongside a browser-based multiplayer IDE with built-in hosting and a database.
best_for: Builders, including non-professional developers, who want to describe an app in plain language and have it built, hosted, and iterated on entirely in the browser, without setting up local tooling.
features: Replit Agent, an AI app builder that writes, evolves, and deploys code from natural-language prompts across websites, mobile apps, data visualizations, and more
Intelligent model routing that selects an AI model per task
Built-in hosting, authentication, and database services for shipping apps without separate infrastructure setup
Multiplayer collaboration for multiple people to work in the same codebase in parallel, with visibility into changes before they merge
Infinite Canvas for visually exploring and tweaking app designs and applying them directly to the app
100+ built-in integrations, including OpenAI, Stripe, and Google Workspace
Native iOS and Android mobile apps for chatting with Agent and editing projects on the go
Database rollback, up to 28 days on the Pro plan, for recovering from mistakes
pros: Starter plan is free and includes a real database and daily Agent credits, not just a stripped-down demo
Hosting, auth, and a database are built in, so an Agent-built app is already deployable without extra setup
Mobile app lets you chat with Agent and edit projects from a phone, not just view them
cons: The free Starter plan limits you to 1 published live project and one background task running at a time
Heavier AI usage draws down monthly model credits, so cost can grow with usage beyond the included allowance on Core and Pro

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Free. Daily complimentary Agent credits, 1 published live project, and one background task at a time, with built-in database access.

tiers.name: Core
tiers.notes: $17/month if billed annually (about 15% less). Includes $20/month of model usage, unlimited workspaces, and the ability to remove Replit branding.

tiers.name: Pro
tiers.notes: $95/month if billed annually (about 15% less). Includes $100/month of model usage, up to 10 parallel Agents, up to 15 collaborators and 50 viewers, and 28-day database rollback.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing. Adds SSO/SAML, custom seat limits, single-tenant environments, and static outbound IPs.

alternatives.name: Cursor
alternatives.description: An AI-first desktop code editor (a VS Code fork) with autonomous Agent mode and access to multiple frontier models.
alternatives.best_for: Professional developers who want AI-assisted coding inside a familiar, local desktop editor rather than a browser-based platform.
strengths: Deep codebase indexing and semantic search
Choice of multiple frontier AI models

alternatives.name: GitHub Copilot
alternatives.description: GitHub and Microsoft's AI pair programmer, available as an extension inside existing editors like VS Code and JetBrains IDEs.
alternatives.best_for: Developers who want AI code completion inside their existing local IDE rather than moving their whole workflow to the browser.

faq.question: Is Replit free?
faq.answer: Yes. Replit's Starter plan is free and includes daily Agent credits, one published live project, and built-in database access. Paid plans start at $20/month (Core, or $17/month billed annually) for more usage.

faq.question: Does Replit have a mobile app?
faq.answer: Yes. The Replit mobile app, available on the Apple App Store and Google Play, lets you chat with Replit Agent and edit projects from a phone; building and submitting native iOS/Android apps still uses Replit's web workflow.

faq.question: Is Replit SOC 2 compliant?
faq.answer: Yes. Replit has completed a SOC 2 Type II audit, renewed annually by an independent CPA firm.
